accelerated_healing.description: Can heal wounds and regenerate damaged skin
accelerated_healing.flavor: They heal faster than their regrets
accelerated_healing.name: Accelerated Healing

adaptation_corruption.description: Adapted to life in a cursed, corrupted biome
adaptation_corruption.flavor: The corruption welcomes all. For a time
adaptation_corruption.name: Corruption Adaptation

adaptation_desert.description: Adapted to life in mysterious deserts
adaptation_desert.flavor: Born from dust, destined to fade into dust
adaptation_desert.name: Arcane Desert Adaptation

adaptation_infernal.description: Adapted to living and building in the infernal biome
adaptation_infernal.flavor: Hell is home, and home is warm
adaptation_infernal.name: Infernal Adaptation

adaptation_permafrost.description: Adapted to life in the permafrost biome
adaptation_permafrost.name: Permafrost Adaptation

adaptation_swamp.description: Adapted to living and building in swamps
adaptation_swamp.flavor: Damp, dark, and full of smells. Just the way they like it
adaptation_swamp.name: Swamp Adaptation

advanced_hippocampus.description: Enhanced memory capabilities allow this species to develop cultures and religions
advanced_hippocampus.name: Advanced Hippocampus

amygdala.description: Grants this species the ability to feel emotions, especially happiness, shaping their behavior and reactions
amygdala.name: Amygdala

antimatter_essence.description: Explodes violently when slain in combat
antimatter_essence.name: Antimatter Essence

aquatic.flavor: They may know some deep secrets
aquatic.name: Aquatic

bad_genes.description: A genetic mutation that can lead to expression of bad traits
bad_genes.name: Bad Genes

big_stomach.description: These species have a huge appetite
big_stomach.flavor: The void within must be fed
big_stomach.name: Big Stomach

bioproduct_gems.flavor: Food goes in, fortune comes out
bioproduct_gems.name: Gem Production

bioproduct_gold.description: Converts consumed nutrients into pure gold
bioproduct_gold.name: Gold Production

bioproduct_mushrooms.description: Nourishes fungi from within, periodically producing mushrooms
bioproduct_mushrooms.name: Mushroom Production

bioproduct_stone.description: Efficiently converts consumed material into stone
bioproduct_stone.name: Stone Production

chaos_driven.description: They are fully awakened during the Age of Chaos
chaos_driven.name: Chaos Driven

circadian_drift.description: They like to sleep when it's light outside
circadian_drift.name: Circadian Drift

cold_resistance.description: Can withstand extreme cold without harm
cold_resistance.flavor: Ice age? More like nice age
cold_resistance.name: Cold Resistance

death_grow_plant.description: On death transforms into a plant!
death_grow_plant.name: Plant Growth

death_grow_tree.description: On death transforms into a tree!
death_grow_tree.name: Tree Growth

diet_algivore.flavor: Others dread algae... they dream of it
diet_algivore.name: Algivore

diet_cannibalism.description: Feeds on members of its own species, a rare and often desperate survival strategy
diet_cannibalism.name: Cannibalism

diet_carnivore.flavor: A balanced diet? Meat, meat, and more meat
diet_carnivore.name: Carnivore

diet_folivore.description: A diet composed mainly of leaves and plants
diet_folivore.name: Folivore

diet_frugivore.description: A diet primarily composed of fruits
diet_frugivore.flavor: If life gives them lemons... they eat them!
diet_frugivore.name: Frugivore

diet_geophagy.flavor: To them, even dirt is a delicacy
diet_geophagy.name: Geophagy

diet_granivore.description: Eats primarily wheat, grains and seeds
diet_granivore.flavor: Every day is a harvest festival!
diet_granivore.name: Granivore

diet_hematophagy.description: They sustain themselves by drinking the blood of others
diet_hematophagy.name: Hematophagy

diet_herbivore.description: A plant-based diet, consumes everything green
diet_herbivore.flavor: Eats greens so you don't have to
diet_herbivore.name: Herbivore

diet_lithotroph.description: Uses stone and minerals for food
diet_lithotroph.flavor: Loves him some rock and stone!
diet_lithotroph.name: Lithotroph

diet_omnivore.flavor: Salad or steak? Why not both?
diet_omnivore.name: Omnivore

diet_piscivore.flavor: The only release fish get is from life itself
diet_piscivore.name: Piscivore

dreamweavers.description: Silently alters the dreams of others, spreading their language, culture, or religion
dreamweavers.flavor: The mind is most open when it's unaware
dreamweavers.name: Dreamweavers

egg_candy.description: Eggs that look and taste like candy
egg_candy.flavor: Sweet on the outside, full of surprises inside
egg_candy.name: Candy

egg_cocoon.description: Eggs that look like a cocoon
egg_cocoon.name: Cocoon

egg_colored.description: Eggs that take phenotype color of these creatures
egg_colored.name: Colored

egg_face.description: Eggs in a form of a weird face

egg_face.name: Face

egg_roe.description: Eggs in a shape of roe
egg_roe.name: Roe

egg_shell_spotted.flavor: Every spot tells a different story
egg_shell_spotted.name: Spotted Shell

exoskeleton.description: Possesses a hard, protective outer shell

fire_elemental_form.name: Fire Elemental Form

gaia_roots.description: They release life-giving clouds upon death

gift_of_air.description: Can shape the air into powerful storms

gift_of_blood.description: Capable of healing through blood magic

gift_of_fire.description: Born with a mastery over flames

gift_of_fire.name: Gift of Fire

pollinating.description: They can pollinate plants and flowers
pollinating.flavor: Making the world a more colorful place
pollinating.name: Pollinator

polyphasic_sleep.description: They take a lot of short naps
polyphasic_sleep.name: Polyphasic Sleep

population_moderate.flavor: Neither too many, nor too few
population_moderate.name: Moderate Population

prefrontal_cortex.description: Allows species to use tools, plan, and start civilizations
prefrontal_cortex.name: Prefrontal Cortex

prolonged_rest.description: They love to take very very long naps
prolonged_rest.name: Prolonged Rest

rapid_aging.flavor: Their lives are brief but intense
rapid_aging.name: Rapid Aging

reproduction_budding.description: Reproduces by growing a new individual directly from their own body
reproduction_budding.name: Budding Reproduction

reproduction_divine.description: Babies can be born through a miracle once in a lifetime!
reproduction_divine.name: Divine Reproduction

reproduction_fission.flavor: One becomes two, two becomes many
reproduction_fission.name: Fission Reproduction

reproduction_hermaphroditic.description: Two creatures of these species are required to make a baby
reproduction_hermaphroditic.name: Hermaphroditic Reproduction

reproduction_metamorph.description: Reproduce by converting the children of other species into offspring of their own kind
reproduction_metamorph.name: Metamorph Reproduction

reproduction_parthenogenesis.description: Females can produce a baby without needing a partner
reproduction_parthenogenesis.name: Parthenogenesis Reproduction

reproduction_sexual.description: A male and a female are required to reproduce
reproduction_sexual.name: Sexual Reproduction

reproduction_soulborne.description: Reproduce by channeling harvested souls into new life of their own kind
reproduction_soulborne.flavor: Each soul fuels the fire of creation
reproduction_soulborne.name: Soulborne Reproduction

reproduction_spores.description: Reproduces through the release of spores
reproduction_spores.name: Spore Reproduction

reproduction_strategy_oviparity.description: Creatures will lay eggs, from which their babies will hatch
reproduction_strategy_oviparity.name: Oviparity

reproduction_strategy_viviparity.description: Babies mature within the momma, emerging ready for life!
reproduction_strategy_viviparity.flavor: Life flows from heart to heart
reproduction_strategy_viviparity.name: Viviparity

reproduction_vegetative.description: Reproduces by breaking into multiple creatures after creature becomes an older adult
reproduction_vegetative.name: Vegetative Reproduction

shiny_love.description: They have a tendency to steal things
shiny_love.name: Shiny Love

slow_builders.description: Takes their time to ensure every detail is perfect
slow_builders.name: Slow Builders

spicy_kids.description: When babies are produced, there is a chance to start a fire
spicy_kids.name: Spicy Kids

stomach.description: This species has a stomach and needs food to survive
stomach.name: Stomach

super_positivity.description: Extremely positive and optimistic. They can't get sad
super_positivity.flavor: Even rain clouds make them smile
super_positivity.name: Super Positivity

telepathic_link.description: Can communicate with others over long distances
telepathic_link.name: Telepathic Link

uplifted.flavor: Now they can think, but can they think of a way out?
uplifted.name: Uplifted

wernicke_area.description: This species can learn and use languages
wernicke_area.flavor: Their minds shape sound into sense
wernicke_area.name: Wernicke's Area

winter_slumberers.description: They sleep a lot when it's cold
winter_slumberers.name: Winter Slumberers
